service.ur: طالب علم کی تعلیمی تاریخ کا سرٹیفکیٹ

about: Get an official certificate of a student's enrolment history at Dubai private schools or early childhood centres.
note: Requirements read from the official KHDA service page on the checked date. KHDA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The student must have been enrolled in a Dubai private school or early childhood centre and be registered in the KHDA system
Extra papers may be asked for if records are incomplete
documents: Enrolment letter from the school if data is not in the KHDA system
Accurate years attended, especially for closed schools
fees: AED 120 in total: AED 100 application and AED 20 Knowledge and Innovation
